brain.commentary: The portfolio is overwhelmingly crypto‑centric and sits in a cross‑asset stress regime. Institutional advisory risk is elevated (0.60). Given these signals we adopt a defensive stance (risk_off) and scale the overall exposure down to 70% of the baseline. Conviction tweaks pull back the fragile core and modestly temper the long bias on the remaining altcoins.
